terms.gloss: trace the route with a finger
terms.comment: A description of ours: lead the way with a finger, on a map. Traupman’s trace is dēlīneāre, to outline (p. 397); no reference work has a phrase for tracing a route.

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 397.
